result.rationale: Company and active owners are right, but fund/vehicle, security, dates, Canadian Solar's 2015 entry/stake basis and former owners need correction. The verified fund is BlackRock Climate Infrastructure Global Renewable Power Fund IV, not inferred 'BlackRock GIF IV.'
result.identityResolution: One global platform founded in 2006. Investee: Recurrent Energy B.V. (Netherlands); ordinary parent: Canadian Solar Energy Group B.V.; ultimate parent: Canadian Solar Inc.; Recurrent Energy, LLC is a U.S. subsidiary. Keep United States / Canada (Austin HQ; Kitchener parent; Guelph O&M). Exclude country units/project SPVs. The transaction excluded China/Japan and specified Latin America/Taiwan assets.

currentOwners.stake: 100% ordinary; 80% as-converted at 2024 close; majority retained

currentOwners.fund: BlackRock Climate Infrastructure Global Renewable Power Fund IV
currentOwners.vehicle: GRP IV Rose Bidco Ltd.; assignee of GRP IV UK Holdco Limited
currentOwners.stake: $500m Series A convertible redeemable preferred; 20% as-converted/voting at close

ownershipResolution.termsAndControl: 9% cumulative quarterly cash/PIK; as-converted vote; one board appointee; 60% Series A consent for reserved acts; liquidation preference=max(1.3x stated value, as-converted); exit request from 2029-05-31. EU found joint control. BlackRock Financial Management, Inc. manages GRP IV; no managed account.

result.operatingResolution: Utility-scale solar/storage developer, selective owner/operator and O&M manager. At 2026-03-31: 23.7 GWp solar pipeline, 80.6 GWh storage pipeline and 15 GW O&M. Last separately reported net operating portfolio was 2.12 GWp/1.809 GWh at 2024-12-31; cutoff-date owned capacity is NOT_PUBLICLY_DISCLOSED because assets are both retained and sold.

acquisitionExitCheck.result: No platform conversion, redemption, dilution transaction, recapitalization, IPO, new investor, transfer, exit, sale or signed pending ownership transaction was disclosed through 2026-08-19; Q1 2026 still reflected preferred dividends.
acquisitionExitCheck.managerReorganization: BlackRock acquired GIP on 2024-10-01; no Recurrent holding transfer was disclosed. Keep BlackRock and note 'GIP, a part of BlackRock.'
acquisitionExitCheck.assetBoundary: Project finance, tax equity, JVs and asset sales do not change platform ownership.
